label: r3_a_direct_probe_q_ablation
config_content:
model:
    name: SuperpositionNetworkProbeQ
    config: default
    mode: ~
runner: PredictionFeaturePredictionRunner
data:
    name: r2_a1random_a2rl
load_state_dict_strict: False
p_mask_vision: 0.99
train:
    loss_function: l1_loss
    pretrain:
        exp_config: exp1_l1
        seed: 0
        epoch: 200
    batch_size: 10
    max_epochs: 200
    save_interval: 10
    test_interval: 10
    optimizer: AdamW
    optim_config:
        default:
            lr: 0.001
            weight_decay: 0.01
        freeze:
            - vision_encoder_module
            - vision_decoder_module
            - integration_module
            - feature_prediction_module
            - share_lns
            - probe_critic
        per_params:
            - name: bias
              args:
                  weight_decay: 0.0
